---
name: Design proposal
about: Propose a driving challenge, route, mission, stunt location or environment change without writing code
title: "[Design] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Idea

Describe the challenge, route, mission or environment change.

## Player objective

What should the player do?

## Existing mechanics used

List the current game systems this uses, for example:

- driving
- drift
- rings
- battery
- compass
- map
- extraction beacon
- terrain
- rocks / trees
- mobile controls

## Route or layout

Attach a sketch, annotated screenshot, route diagram or describe the area clearly.

## Difficulty

Explain what makes it easy, medium or difficult.

## Success condition

What counts as completing the challenge?

## Notes

Anything a developer would need to implement it.

No code is required for a design proposal.
